info.title: Mekong Logistics Foundation API
info.description: Cookie-authenticated first-party API. All tenant resources are explicitly organization-scoped. APP_URL and frontend share one public origin. Bootstrap CSRF cookies before mutations. See api.md for role matrix, pagination, errors and throttles.
